class: Development only; text-free (no plate text, no text hash)

annotationsDigest.rule: sha256 over sorted lines '<relative path>\0<sha256(annotations.json bytes)>\n' (aggregate only; per-file annotation hashes are not recorded)

rule.assignment: EVAL if int(sha256('lrlpr26-split-v1|' + min normalised text in group), 16) % 2 == 1, else DEV
rule.blockSplit: secondary only: block = (scenario, trackNumber // 500); EVAL if int(sha256('lrlpr26-block-v1|' + scenario + '|' + str(block)), 16) % 2 == 1, else DEV; a plate-identity group with tracks on both block sides is a conflict group and its EVAL-side tracks are EXCLUDED
rule.groupIndex: groups numbered 0.. in order of their smallest track number
rule.groups: union-find components over tracks sharing a normalised plate text (MAVI normalise) or any byte-identical image (LR or HR, per-file manifest SHA-256)
